_note: Fees as published on each company's own pages on the read date. 'rate' values feed the net-proceeds calculator; a venue with no published rate on the page we read has no modes and is left out of the calculator. Review quarterly.

venues.name: Sedo
venues.best: The widest international reach. Priced names are also offered through its registrar partner network.
venues.fees: 10% when the name has a buy-now price and is parked or uses Sedo's sales page; 15% for make-offer or auction; 20% when the buyer comes through the partner network. A 3% transfer-only service exists for deals you close yourself.

modes.label: Buy now, parked or on Sedo's sales page, sold direct
Make offer or auction, sold direct

venues.source: Sedo 'Buy, Park, Sell' page; DomainGang's breakdown of Sedo's own fee explanation

venues.name: Afternic
venues.best: Puts priced names in front of people searching at partner registrars, with in-house brokers and a lead centre for inquiries.
venues.fees: No commission figure is stated on the brokerage page we read. Check the current fee schedule in your account before you list.

venues.name: Saw.com
venues.best: Self-serve for-sale pages with live chat and lease-to-own built in, with brokers available when a deal needs one.

venues.name: Dynadot
venues.best: Low-friction listings and auctions for names already held at the registrar, plus expired-name auctions for buyers.
venues.fees: 10% on user listings and auctions; 5% when the sale completes through a Pay Link. Inbound brokerage 10% (minimum $50); outbound brokerage for ultra-premium names 15%.

modes.label: Pay Link, when you bring the buyer

venues.source: Dynadot aftermarket page and brokerage help article

venues.name: Namecheap Market
venues.best: Budget and mid-priced names listed straight from a Namecheap account in a few clicks.
venues.fees: Flat 10% per transaction. Asking prices from $5 to $1,000,000.
venues.source: Namecheap knowledge-base article on listing a domain

venues.name: Spaceship SellerHub
venues.best: Sellers who want modern for-sale pages, lease-to-own and names imported from any registrar.
venues.fees: 10% per sale; 5% on checkout and self-serve links, according to the SellerHub FAQ text. The page itself did not load for us on the read date, so confirm on the site.
venues.source: Spaceship SellerHub FAQ text as shown in search results

venues.name: Flippa
venues.best: Names with a story: an old site, traffic or revenue attached. Buyers there shop for businesses as well as names.
venues.fees: Listing packages from $29, plus a success fee of 3% to 10% depending on the value of the asset.

modes.label: Success fee, at most (falls towards 3% on larger assets; listing package from $29 extra)

venues.name: Atom
venues.best: Coined, brandable names. Accepted listings are shown at a fixed price with logo files, and many carry a payment plan.
venues.fees: No seller commission is stated on the page we read. Check the seller terms before you submit names.

venues.name: BrandBucket
venues.best: Startup-style brandables sold at a fixed price with a sample logo. Listings we saw ran from about $1,500 to $8,400.
venues.fees: Seller terms are not stated on the page we read.

venues.name: An independent broker
venues.best: High-value names where finding and persuading one specific buyer is the whole job.
venues.fees: Usually a percentage of the sale price, commonly 10% to 20%, and almost always with an exclusivity period.

venues.name: Escrow.com
venues.best: Closing a sale you found yourself. The buyer pays the escrow company, the name moves, then you are paid.
venues.fees: 2.6% (minimum $50) on domains up to $5,000, falling in steps to 0.7% above $10 million. The concierge service starts at 5.2% (minimum $100).

venues.name: Your own for-sale page
venues.best: Keeps the buyer relationship and the margin with you. You do the marketing; an escrow service handles the money.
venues.fees: No commission. Budget for the escrow fee on the deal.
venues.source: Build one with the for-sale page builder on this site

venues.name: Investor communities
venues.best: Moving names quickly to other investors at wholesale prices, using standard sale templates and trader ratings.
venues.fees: Expect investor pricing, a fraction of what an end user would pay.

venues.name: DomainEasy
venues.best: Offering a buyer monthly payments. It publishes three structures: lease-to-own for $1,000 to $50,000 names, a deposit plan for $50,000 to $500,000, and a balloon plan above that.
venues.fees: Seller pricing is managed in the seller dashboard and is not listed on the financing page.

venues.name: Efty
venues.best: Investors who want their own branded storefront, for-sale pages and portfolio tracking in one place.
venues.fees: No pricing is shown on the product page we read.
